charge_port.notes: Estimated: North American EX40/XC40 Recharge use CCS1 (the 2026 EX40 is confirmed CCS by a Canadian Volvo dealer article, and Volvo sells a NACS-to-CCS1 adapter for all its EVs, which would be pointless with a native NACS port). Nothing shows a port change between 2021 and 2026 (no native NACS on any Volvo EV before the EX60). Applies to 2022 P8 Twin eAWD (US).
Estimated: The Charge Port 2026 US checker lists EX40 / XC40 Recharge (2021-2025) as CCS1 (adapter needed for Superchargers).

supercharger_access.notes: Volvo Canada release: owners of fully electric Volvo cars (all existing EVs) can order a NACS-to-CCS1 adapter at authorized retailers (CA$310) and use Tesla Superchargers from Nov 18 2024; the adapter is included with new 2025 EX90/EX40/EC40.
US: adapter ($230) sold to existing Volvo EV owners via retailers; free with 2025 EX90/EX40/EC40.
